mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output and strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850.0 thousand units triggers a slowdown in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
